cohort: 100 pregnant women in labor (50 with preeclampsia and 50 normotensive)
finding: Pregnant women with preeclampsia had significantly lower vitamin D and calcium levels compared to normotensive pregnant women, and their neonates also had lower cord blood vitamin D levels.
mod_finding: A significantly higher proportion of women with vitamin D levels below 15 ng/ml underwent cesarean section compared to those with levels above 15 ng/ml.
birth_weight: Not specified, but study measured incidence of low birth weight
